comment: This is an English class and also a film class. The only film class he taught recent semesters and probably the only one that he will continue teaching. So, film students, you are "lucky". Consult previous ratings for what led to this situation.

A lot of people really don't like this guy but I actually enjoyed his class. I'm not an English major so the readings were a lot for me (expect to read upwards of 50 pages some nights) but classes are discussion based and he has interesting interpretations of the text. I don't recommend him for anyone bad at English, but I think he's over-hated.

Class is fairly boring, feedback is unclear majority of the time.  Thought I was doing well in the class and got blindsided by final grade, unfortunately an essay and a final exam were due within 3 days of each other.

The entire class hated him by the end of the semester. He holds a lot of problematic opinions and talks down on Black students who tried to educate him about colorism, which was surprising that he had no idea what that was in a class that was supposed to be on race. The class was not focused, lectures were just him rambling, grading was arbitrary.
Don't take his class!!!!!
grades based on nothing but his own subjective impression on you and you will never know your final grades until you can't change anything, prepared to have a big C surprise for the vacation
unreasonably unfair grader, cares more about his dog than any of his students, and his dog has more freedom wandering around the classroom while students are prohibited to go to restroom

DO NOT TAKE THIS TEACHER. He didn't submit a single grade until the very last day and I didn't know I had a C+. I participated every second of class and still got a bad grade on participation because I "used the bathroom every so often". He never responded to my emails. Might be the worst teacher I've ever had and the class itself was horrendous.
What suits him better than being a professor is going back to kindergarten to learn the most basic respect. Disappointed as someone who wanted to take film minor, the professor ruins everything

CONDENSCENDING DICTATOR, FORBID student to go to restroom or HOSPITAL, IGNORE email, cancel class & meeting ANY TIME, MOST DISRESPECTFUL EVER, giving half terms in test in French just to SHOW OFF HIS FRENCH
He is tough to all non-native speakers and emphasizes it again and again during the class. He even changed his syllabus in the pre-final week. DON'T TAKE HIS CLASS!
Dr. Lurie is a tough grader on the papers but as long as you send him a draft and edit it with his comments and participate in class you will do great :)
One word to describe this dude: POMPOUS. Would not take again and only took his course because it was mandatory. Ugh!

Peter Lurie is uneducated about anything related to race. He is the epitome of white liberal men. He has a has a PHD in English and Film studies, but believes that he is educated enough to teach a class about race. When challenged about his ideas in class about what he thinks, he often dismisses or talks over you if he feels like you're off topic.

No matter what you do, don't take this class. His expectations are unclear, he constantly contradicts himself and will grade you based on absolutely nothing. He is easily irritable and will not allow you to form any ideas that aren't his. No one in my class received an A. He was creating final questions as we were taking the final. Enough said.

I personally didn't hate this guy as I thought he liked me as a student but he's pretty pompous and will just dismiss your idea if he doesn't agree. Really harsh grader on essays don't expect above a B+ unless you write exactly how he wants. He has pre set ideas he wants you to discuss and write about and doesn't welcome new ideas. Smart guy tho.

Dr. Lurie the kind of person that is very passionate about what he teaches and can be condescending especially to people who aren't as interested in it (it's Faulkner). I did pretty well in the class and felt prepared by my high school for it, and so had a relatively positive experience with Dr. Lurie. Be prepared for tedious readings.

Very condescending. Liberal arts guy that takes ten minutes to say nothing of meaning and act like Socrates after saying it. Will say tons of positive things on your paper, only to give a B-. The books he worships are a chore to read, and intentionally convoluted. >50% my finals workload was my FYS. 8-10 pg paper and exam with essays. Bad professor

Professor Lurie is very condescending and unhelpful. He assigns way too much reading and grades insanely hard. I dreaded going to his class and felt like I was losing years of my life sitting in that room. Do not recommend unless you want to struggle and deal with a rude professor. Hardest fys, do not take Faulkner.

Dr. Lurie is very knowledgable & you will learn a lot from him. However, he is very condescending & if you have issues with class participation, it will not fly. I reached out for help and after he assured me he would, I never got any and it caused even more problems. Very tough grader and you must write papers exactly how he wants. LOTS OF READING

Very condescending professor. Expects students to know poetry and literary terms that I have not heard since high school. Does not understand that this is a gen ed class and were not all devote poetry readers with a deep understanding of poetry before taking the class.

I was really turned off by Professor Lurie. I found him to be incredibly arrogant and condescending in class. He dismisses points that he does not personally agree with, and has a confrontational and pedantic approach. I'm sure he is very smart, but he comes across as so pompous. As an English major, I tried to avoid taking classes with him.

Dr. Lurie cares about his students and will definitely guide you if you reach out to him when you are struggling. He is one of the most intelligent professors/teachers I have encountered, and his course content is interesting. It can be a lot in a little amount of time, but you will definitely learn.

He asks questions and doesn't listen to your answer. If you're a girl, he will constantly interrupt you (he does it to boys too sometimes, but not as often). He is very rude and condescending. Stay away if you can manage...

There are two types of professors: those who want original thoughts in papers, and those who will mark you down if you don't regurgitate their own ideas back to them. Peter Lurie is the latter. If you disagree with him on a possible interpretation of lit/film,  it does not matter how much evidentiary support you have, he will give you a bad grade.

Dr. Lurie is unprofessional and rude during lecture. He picks on students who he doesn't like, and he frequently makes mistakes during his lecture. The class was on film and we often talked about history, but I found myself losing respect for him when he constantly got historical facts wrong, and then if challenged, he would arrogantly ignore you.

Really smart guy. He guides discussion effectively, unlike many other english professors who take a hands-off approach. As a result, you can expect to get a lot out of his classes. He is always open to meeting about your papers, so take him up on that and he will point you in the right direction. Genuinely cares about his students.

Dr. Lurie is clearly a really smart guy. His classes aren't as discussion based as some other English classes I've taken, in the sense that he heavily guides them. You'll learn a lot, but it won't be too easy. I would take him again.

As an English major, I took this class to try to explore film as it relates to English. However, I found Dr. Lurie incredibly rude and unprofessional. I was singled out at least once in every class and it got to the point where I was afraid to look up in class because I was so uncomfortable. I would absolutely not take him again.

Lurie is extremely smart and a very traditional professor. He is by the book and extremely professional. Perhaps what bothers people most is that he is so genuinely interested in the topics he teaches that he wastes no words or time on anything else. If you don't do the readings or don't seem to enjoy the class, he'll know and call on you often.

This guy doesn't know anything about film analysis.  His critiques of your papers are absurdly critical and not relevant. Exactly what others have said, he thinks he is much smarter than he is. His grading is opinionated and non informative.

If you don't have an interest in film, he's probably not going to get you to like it. Lurie is really dry and super prude. But if you've got an interest in the subject and prior experience, he's not a bad teacher to have.

Arrogant.  Annoying.  Judgmental.  If he were half as intelligent as he believes himself to be, this class would be worth your while.  Unfortunately, he takes pride in embarrassing students.  Someone is still self-conscious of his GRE scores...
Had him YEARS ago when he was a teaching assistant. Smart fellow. Probably more easy going back then.

He is the most pompus arrogant man I have EVER met. I is VERY opinionated hates contrary views. And if you take to long to get your book out of your bag or go to the bathroom, he WILL ask you if you care about your college education, wtf?

Had him for Core.Took us a month to understand what he was saying. He definitely knows what he's talking about, but he's the professoriest of professors, so it was really tough for a while. Will call you out in class, so be prepared.  Helped me get acclimated to college climate, but standoffish and kinda intimidating. Still have mixed feelings.

Probably the most intelligent professor in the Eng dept. Some here say that he always guns you down, but if you offer a comment that at least respects his intelligence, he'll love it. Not easy; work hard, and an A- is poss. Most rewarding A- ever. Be warned, his classes are very much grounded in scholarly theory. Nonmajors may want to avoid him.

Unbelievely intelligent professor.  I missed a lot of class and his attendance policy definitely hurt me.  However, if you know what you are talking about he will at least respect your effort even when he doesn't find your response acceptable, which is pretty much all the time.  If you the reading and go to class getting at least a B is attainable.
Phenominaly opinionated. Real nice and sounds smart, but doesn't listen to what students say or accept alternate interpretations.

Wins awards in the following categories: most intelligent, friendliest, most approachable, most prepared, most understandable... Look, if you're expecting an easy class where you won't have to do any work, don't take Lurie. But, if you want to learn from a great instructor, then sign up ASAP!

Originally he seemed like a tremendously pompus man but as the class progressed I realized that he just tries to scare kids off in the begining but once the first month is over the class is great.  He is BY FAR the best professor I've had at UR.  Knowledgable and willing to listen you will learn a lot but don't expcet an A unless you kill yourself

Lurie is easily one of the best, most knowledgeable professors I've ever had. He might not seem accessible in class, but that's just his style. He does care about how well you learn, even if that doesn't come across. He knows his stuff and you will learn a lot. Don't expect an easy A and you'll enjoy this class.
No Comments
A horrible class.....
ok class
He challenges students when they say something stupid in class. Some people don't like that. Personally, I wish more profs would do that. He is a smart guy who knows a lot about his subject.

terrible professor- the subject is interesting, but lurie sucks the fun out of it. He is pompous and openly calls you out in class.  even doing all of the reading won't enable you to participate without being cut down.  DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS!

An excellent teacher.  He is very eccentric, but is a genuinly nice guy, which you will find out if you visit him during his hours.  Passionate about the subject and very knowledgable.  Highly recommended.

He is a hard grader and that is mostly because he is so knowledgable in the subject himself.  He expects a lot from students and will not let anyone get by without trying. He is really interesting outside of class and has a lot to teach people. You just ave to be willing to give him a chance.
No Comments
Sometimes he can come off as having no personality, but if you visit him outside of class, you will learn that this is not true. He is a very intelligent professor and I learned a lot from him.
Huge jerk, horrible teacher, no personality, out of touch, worst professor I have ever had.

Take this man if you want to put a gun to your head. He's pompous, always makes references to having gone to Harvard. He mumbles at the end of a sentence so you don't know what vital piece of information he just said will be on the midterm (or what page to turn to).He never finishes a thought!
He is rude and unconcerned with students real opinions.
